# opalstack_site (Data Source)

Looks up a site by `id` or by `name`.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "opalstack_site" "www" {
  name = "www"
}

output "www_domains" {
  value = data.opalstack_site.www.domain_ids
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `id` (String) UUID of the site.
- `name` (String) Name of the site.

### Read-Only

- `cert_id` (String) UUID of the certificate the site serves, if any.
- `disabled` (Boolean) Whether the site is switched off.
- `domain_ids` (Set of String) UUIDs of the domains the site answers for.
- `generate_le` (Boolean) Whether a Let's Encrypt certificate is requested for the site.
- `ip4_id` (String) UUID of the IPv4 address the site listens on, if any.
- `ip6_id` (String) UUID of the IPv6 address the site listens on, if any.
- `primary_domain_id` (String) UUID of the domain the others redirect to, if one is set.
- `redirect` (Boolean) Whether the other domains redirect to the primary one.
- `routes` (Attributes Set) Which app answers which path. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--routes))
- `server_id` (String) UUID of the server the site is served from.

<a id="nestedatt--routes"></a>
### Nested Schema for `routes`

Read-Only:

- `app_id` (String) UUID of the app.
- `uri` (String) Path prefix the app answers.
